_note: v2 counter-screen rune swaps. team score = sum over enemies having the threat; the star lane opponent counts lane_weight instead of 1; rule fires when score >= min, or (lane_trigger) when the lane opponent alone has the threat (blocked if he has any lane_exclude tag). When 2 fired rules want the same tree+row slot, highest score*weight wins. Resolve row 2 is contested by Second Wind (poke 3.0) > Nullifying Orb (ap_heavy 2.75) > Bone Plating (burst 2.5): poke wins because it is a sustained, lane-long drain, then mass-AP, then burst; this ordering applies only when two rules fire at once. Rows follow rune_assign.json rows. ap_heavy = enemy with dmg_split.ap >= ap_heavy_min_ap (fallback: has dmg_ap and not dmg_ad). Keystone rules apply only when a lane opponent is set; {lane} = his name.

minor_rules.reason_ar: يوجد {n} من الأعداء الأقوياء في التحمّل — Cut Down يزيد ضررك على الأهداف ذات الصحة العالية
minor_rules.reason_en: {n} tanky enemies — Cut Down adds damage against high-health targets

minor_rules.reason_ar: يضغط عليك {n} من الأعداء بضرر بعيد متكرر — Second Wind يعوّض صحتك بعد كل ضربة
minor_rules.reason_en: {n} enemies poke you down — Second Wind regenerates health after taking damage

minor_rules.reason_ar: أغلب الأعداء ({n}) ضررهم سحري — Nullifying Orb يحميك بدرع عند تلقّي ضرر سحري
minor_rules.reason_en: {n} enemies deal mostly magic damage — Nullifying Orb shields you from it

minor_rules.reason_ar: يستطيع {n} من الأعداء قتلك بكومبو واحد — Bone Plating يقلّل الضربات الأولى عليك
minor_rules.reason_en: {n} enemies can burst you — Bone Plating blunts the opening hits

minor_rules.reason_ar: يملك {n} من الأعداء تحكماً (CC) كثيراً — Perseverance يرفع دفاعك عند الإبطاء والشلل
minor_rules.reason_en: {n} enemies have heavy crowd control — Perseverance raises your defenses when slowed or stunned

keystone_rules.reason_ar: خصمك {lane} يضغط عليك من بعيد — Fleet Footwork يعطيك علاجاً وسرعة للاقتراب منه
keystone_rules.reason_en: {lane} pokes you from range — Fleet Footwork gives sustain and speed to close in

keystone_rules.reason_ar: خصمك {lane} قوي في التحمّل — Grasp of the Undying يمنحك صحة وضرراً في المواجهات الطويلة
keystone_rules.reason_en: {lane} is tanky — Grasp of the Undying wins the long trades
